what: Pressing a screen-corner button (triangle · circle) pushes an accent-color panel (1/3 of screen width, min 20rem — full width on phones) out from beyond that edge on 1s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), and .6s later the menu and photos inside turn on over .75s. If the other side’s panel is open, it closes. When closed by the close button or Esc, the content switches off first in .2s and the panel leaves the same way. Hovering a menu row turns on the photo of the same number in .25s (the original lays the photo over the accent color with multiply)

options.delay: Wait before content turns on (s), default .6
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open button — anywhere outside the panel, with aria-controls set to the panel id
options.[data-fx-part=content]: Content that turns on once the panel is fully out (multiple allowed)
options.[data-fx-part=item]·[data-fx-part=pic]: Photo with the same data-key as the menu row
options.fx:open·fx:close: Events the panel emits on open and close — when scrolling stops and resumes
